description: AMPLITUDE FUNNELS: conversion and drop-off across ordered steps. Pass `events` as an ORDERED array of at least two steps. mode is ordered / unordered / sequential. conversionWindowSeconds is how long a user has to complete the funnel and DEFAULTS TO 2,592,000 SECONDS (30 DAYS) — ALWAYS state which window a conversion rate was measured over, because a 30-day window makes a funnel look dramatically healthier than a same-session one and the difference is invisible in the number itself. At most ONE group-by: segmentation allows two, funnels do not, and a second is refused by name rather than silently dropped. Returns step-by-step and cumulative conversion plus median and average transition times. Read-only, 0 credits.

conversionWindowSeconds.description: Amplitude default is 2592000 (30 days) — say which window you used

events.description: ordered steps — plain event names, or {eventType, filters:[…]} objects

groupBy.description: at most ONE — a second is refused

segments.description: FILTER to only these users (Amplitude's segment `s`): [{prop:'gp:utm_campaign', op:'is', values:['summer']}]. op is one of is, is not, contains, does not contain, less, less or equal, greater, greater or equal, set is, set is not. Custom user properties are gp:<name>; built-ins are country, city, region, platform, os, device_type, version, language, paying; prop userdata_cohort + a cohort id filters to a behavioural cohort. A "who performed" condition is {type:'event', event_type, op:'>=', value:1, time_type:'rolling', time_value:30} (did it at least once in the last 30 days); symbol operators only.

event_type.description: event name for a who-performed condition

op.description: property operator, e.g. is, is not, contains; symbol (>=) on a who-performed condition

prop.description: user property to filter on: built-in (country, platform), gp:<name> for custom, or userdata_cohort

type.description: 'event' for a who-performed condition; omit for a property filter

value.description: who-performed count threshold; default 1 (at least once)

values.description: values the property must match, e.g. ["summer"]

users.description: 'new' = first-time users only (the acquisition funnel); Amplitude's default is active

name: amplitude_funnel
title: Amplitude funnel (conversion + drop-off)
